rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials (zone 406 -> about 360); behind the buildings the residential yards rule - one tree for every two or three houses, never against a fence or a wall
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's twelve builder trees go (four eucalyptus in a line 11 m apart, a line of corals, ficus, a jacaranda and a queen palm 1.5-2.2 m from the west fence, broadleaf on the lawn); four come back on their own spots: two on the open lawn 20 m from the walls, two of the eucalyptus line 32 m apart.

trees.why: the open lawn at the east, 20 m from the walls: a full coral tree
the same lawn 25 m west, 20 m from the walls: the lawn's second tree
the north end of the old eucalyptus line, 10 m from the building
the same line 32 m south: every other eucalyptus kept
